subject.statement: Iñaki Urdangarin fue condenado en el caso Nóos.

summary: Iñaki Urdangarin was convicted in the Nóos case by the Balearic Islands High Court in February 2017, and the conviction was upheld by Spain's Supreme Court in 2018. As of 2026-10-01, the conviction remains on record.
